long_biography.plain_text:
Yacht manager Declan O'Sullivan worked with Baltic Yachts and Evolution Sails on the restoration of a neglected sailing yacht for charter. The four-month project renewed mechanical systems, rebuilt the engine and replaced damaged decks. Finnish cabinetmakers supplied interior modules for installation in Palma, while the work also included commercial certification.

At Pelagos, his team approaches registration as a connected set of decisions. The owner's tax position, intended cruising area and choice between private use and commercial operation determine the appropriate structure. For charter work, the firm considers flag registration alongside crew qualifications and VAT planning.
